nodes.label: ARIA Labels for Icon-Only Buttons
nodes.rationale: Found multiple instances where icon-only buttons lacked accessible names. Always verify that interactive elements, especially icon-only buttons, have an aria-label attribute if they do not contain visible text content.

nodes.label: Accessibility Audit (WCAG 2.2 / WCAG-EM)
nodes.rationale: Whole site or product audit against WCAG 2.2 following WCAG-EM. Defines scope, samples representative pages and flows, runs automated scan and manual inspect tiers, produces one conformance report. Assesses; does not fix (use accessibility-fix) or diff (use accessibility-diff). One page with no sampling is a scan, not an audit.

nodes.label: WCAG-EM Methodology
nodes.rationale: WCAG-EM steps: Scope, Explore, Sample, Evaluate, Report. Conformance has three states: pass/fail only for verified findings; everything flagged/human-required/not-exercised is undetermined.

nodes.label: Evidence Basis Grading
nodes.rationale: Evidence basis: verified (deterministic with cited proof), flagged (evidence captured, person decides), human-required (needs assistive technology or lived experience). Severity: critical/serious/moderate/minor.

nodes.label: Per-SC Conformance Ledger
nodes.rationale: Pass/fail asserted only for verified criteria. Flagged/human-required/not-exercised are undetermined and go to human. One sampled page failing an SC fails it for the whole scope at that level.

nodes.label: Shared Methodology (../shared/methodology.md)
nodes.rationale: Shared grounding and honesty conventions referenced by accessibility-audit, accessibility-diff, accessibility-fix, accessibility-inspect, accessibility-scan. Covers severity, no-proxy boundary, grounding.

nodes.label: Accessibility Diff (Regression Check)
nodes.rationale: Diff a live page's a11y violations against a baseline. Stash mode (uncommitted changes) or branch mode. Reports new violations introduced, ones fixed, and pre-existing count. Locate; don't fix.

nodes.label: Stash Mode Baseline
nodes.rationale: Default mode: stash uncommitted changes, scan baseline, restore working tree, scan again, compare snapshots. Warns user before stashing; working tree fully restored.

nodes.label: Branch Mode Baseline
nodes.rationale: Compare against a branch: checkout branch to capture baseline, then restore. CLI opens fresh tab each run; use --wait-for as rebuild gate for slow builds.

nodes.label: Accessibility Fix (Remediation)
nodes.rationale: Remediation only — repair a11y violations against WCAG 2.2 with baseline, edit, verify loop. Applies mechanical fixes, leaves TODOs for contextual/visual judgment. Only fixes; doesn't find issues.

nodes.label: Baseline-Edit-Verify Loop
nodes.rationale: Audit before and after; compare violation sets. Every targeted violation gone, no new ones. Use audit_live for URLs, audit_html for raw HTML/JSX strings.

nodes.label: Accessibility Inspect (Manual Tier)
nodes.rationale: Semi-automated manual tier: keyboard operation, focus order, screen-reader names/roles/states from a11y tree, reflow/zoom, reduced motion, form errors, target size. Locates and assesses; does not fix.

nodes.label: Inspect Ledger (verified/flagged/N/A/not exercised)
nodes.rationale: Every criterion in checkpoint areas ends in exactly one state: verified/flagged/N/A/not exercised. Not exercised = undetermined, never silently dropped or passed as pass.

nodes.label: Evidence Budget
nodes.rationale: Verified = full proof gathered once. Flagged = one selector, one screenshot, handoff note, then stop. Human-required = zero driving. Grade bounds evidence worth gathering.

nodes.label: Batched Keyboard Walk
nodes.rationale: Traverse focus in a single evaluate_script call; compute tabbable sequence, focus each element, return compact JSON per stop (selector, role/name, activeElement confirmation, focus outline/box-shadow, bounding box, overlay rect check). Deterministic DOM fact, ●-citable.

nodes.label: Accessibility Scan (Automated Tier)
nodes.rationale: Rule engine over live DOM via CDP. Returns worklist of WCAG 2.2 violations grounded to DOM selector and source file:line. Locates; doesn't edit. Ensures debuggable Chrome via @accesslint/chrome.

nodes.label: Inspect Checkpoints
nodes.rationale: Per-checkpoint procedures and default grades for 8 areas: keyboard & focus (2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.4.3, 2.4.7, 2.4.11), structure & semantics (1.3.1, 1.3.2, 2.4.1, 2.4.6), names/roles/states (4.1.2, 2.5.3, 4.1.3), visual adaptation (1.4.4, 1.4.10, 1.4.12, 1.3.4, 2.3.3, 1.4.1, 1.4.11), forms & errors (3.3.1-3.3.3, 1.3.5, 3.3.7, 3.3.8), media & timing (1.2.x, 2.2.1, 2.2.2), pointer & target (2.5.7, 2.5.8, 2.5.1), content & navigation (3.1.1/2, 2.4.4, 3.2.3/4, 3.2.6).

nodes.label: API and Interface Design
nodes.rationale: Design stable, well-documented interfaces hard to misuse. Applies to REST APIs, GraphQL schemas, module boundaries, component props, database schema. Good interfaces make the right thing easy and wrong thing hard.

nodes.label: Hyrum's Law
nodes.rationale: With sufficient users, all observable behaviors become depended on regardless of contract. Be intentional about what you expose; don't leak implementation details; plan for deprecation at design time.

nodes.label: One-Version Rule
nodes.rationale: Avoid diamond dependency problems; design for a world where only one version exists at a time — extend rather than fork.

nodes.label: Contract First
nodes.rationale: Define the interface before implementing it. The contract is the spec; implementation follows. Typed input and output schemas for every endpoint.

nodes.label: Idempotency Key
nodes.rationale: Derive key from intent not attempt; claim atomically via unique constraint; guard payload (same key + different body fails loudly); decide in-flight duplicate strategy (409/wait/202). Key retention must outlive longest retry path including DLQ replay.

nodes.label: Context Engineering
nodes.rationale: Optimizes agent context setup: curate what the agent sees, when, and how structured. Context is the single biggest lever for agent output quality.

nodes.label: Context Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Five levels: 1) Rules files (always loaded), 2) Spec/architecture docs (per feature), 3) Relevant source files (per task), 4) Error output (per iteration), 5) Conversation history (accumulates, compacts).

nodes.label: Context Budget Management
nodes.rationale: Start trimming at 75% capacity, not 100%. Cut past failures, verbose output, conversational back-and-forth, replaced drafts first. Protect task definition, current error, active file, hard constraints. Compress before dropping.

nodes.label: Debugging and Error Recovery
nodes.rationale: Systematic root-cause debugging with structured triage. Stop-the-Line Rule: stop adding features, preserve evidence, diagnose, fix root cause, guard against recurrence, resume only after verification.

nodes.label: Triage Checklist
nodes.rationale: Six steps in order: Reproduce, Localize, Reduce, Fix Root Cause, Guard Against Recurrence, Verify End-to-End. Do not skip steps. Use bisection (git bisect) for regression bugs.

nodes.label: Deprecation and Migration
nodes.rationale: Code is a liability, not an asset. Deprecation = removing code that no longer earns its keep; migration = moving users safely from old to new. Deprecation planning starts at design time.

nodes.label: Expand/Contract Schema Migration
nodes.rationale: Never change a column in place. Expand (add nullable column) → Migrate (dual-write + backfill in batches) → Contract (drop old column in separate deploy). Each step independently deployable and reversible.

nodes.label: Strangler Pattern
nodes.rationale: Run old and new systems in parallel; route traffic incrementally from old to new (0%→10%→50%→100%); remove old system at 0% traffic.

nodes.label: Find Documentation (Context7)
nodes.rationale: Retrieve up-to-date documentation via Context7 CLI. Two-step: resolve library ID, then query docs. Always verify against current docs, not training data. Max 3 attempts per question.

nodes.label: Find Skills (Skills CLI)
nodes.rationale: Discover and install agent skills from the open skills ecosystem. npx skills find/add/update. Verify install count (1K+), source reputation, GitHub stars before recommending.

nodes.label: Observability and Instrumentation
nodes.rationale: Instrument code alongside the feature, not as post-launch add-on. Structured logging, RED/USE metrics, OpenTelemetry tracing, symptom-based alerting with runbooks.

nodes.label: Structured Logging
nodes.rationale: Log events not prose: JSON with stable event name + machine-readable fields. Correlation IDs mandatory on every line. Entry-point field for multi-entry-point sinks. Never log secrets/PII.

nodes.label: RED Metrics (Rate/Errors/Duration)
nodes.rationale: For every endpoint and external dependency. Histograms not averages; p50/p95/p99. Bounded label sets — never user IDs, raw URLs, or error messages as labels (cardinality bomb).

nodes.label: Symptom-Based Alerting
nodes.rationale: Alert on symptoms users feel, not causes. Two severities: page (user-facing, act now) and ticket (degradation, act this week). Every alert links to a runbook; test-fire each alert once.

nodes.label: Performance Optimization
nodes.rationale: Measure before optimizing. Profile first, identify actual bottleneck, fix, measure again, guard against regression. Core Web Vitals targets: LCP ≤2.5s, INP ≤200ms, CLS ≤0.1.

nodes.label: Core Web Vitals
nodes.rationale: LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) ≤2.5s good; INP (Interaction to Next Paint) ≤200ms good; CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) ≤0.1 good. Synthetic + RUM measurement approaches.

nodes.label: Optimization Workflow (Measure/Identify/Fix/Verify/Guard)
nodes.rationale: Five-step workflow. Re-measure same way as baseline. Change one thing at a time. Neutral is a revert, not a keep. Log every attempt including reverted ones.

nodes.label: N+1 Queries Pattern
nodes.rationale: One query per row is the most common backend bottleneck. Fetch the relation in the same query (join/include) instead of in the loop.

nodes.label: Unbounded Data Fetching
nodes.rationale: Every list endpoint paginates with a limit and a stable order. Don't fetch all records.

nodes.label: Query Index Optimization
nodes.rationale: EXPLAIN ANALYZE is the measurement. Index for query shape (equality columns first, then range/sort column). Re-run plan after; index that didn't change plan is a revert.

nodes.label: Connection Pool Exhaustion
nodes.rationale: One pool per process sized under database ceiling. Bigger pool relocates queue to database. Use pgbouncer/RDS Proxy for unbounded instance counts (serverless/autoscaling).

nodes.label: Image Optimization
nodes.rationale: Declare width/height for CLS. LCP image gets fetchpriority=high, modern formats via picture, srcset/sizes. Below-fold images get loading=lazy and decoding=async.

nodes.label: Unnecessary Re-renders (React)
nodes.rationale: Hoist constants; use React.memo/useMemo only when profile shows expensive work. Overuse is its own cost. New object/function in render causes child re-renders.

nodes.label: Large Bundle Size
nodes.rationale: Route-level code splitting and lazy-loading behind Suspense. Modern bundlers tree-shake ESM named imports; profile before changing import styles.

nodes.label: Missing Caching (Backend)
nodes.rationale: Cache expensive + frequently-read data. Key must include all inputs (tenant, locale, viewer). One invalidation strategy (TTL/event/versioned). Guard against stampede with stale-while-revalidate or coalescing.

nodes.label: Planning and Task Breakdown
nodes.rationale: Decompose work into small verifiable tasks with acceptance criteria. Vertical slicing: build complete feature paths (schema+API+UI) rather than horizontal layers (all DB then all API then all UI).

nodes.label: Vertical Slicing
nodes.rationale: Build one complete feature path at a time instead of all database, then all API, then all UI. Each vertical slice delivers working, testable functionality.

nodes.label: Task Sizing Guidelines
nodes.rationale: XS(1 file)/S(1-2)/M(3-5)/L(5-8)/XL(8+). If L or larger, break down further. Agent performs best on S and M tasks. Checkpoints after every 2-3 tasks.

nodes.label: Spec-Driven Development
nodes.rationale: Write spec before code. Four gated phases: Specify → Plan → Tasks → Implement. Human reviews at each gate. Stop after writing spec; do not start plan or code in same turn.

nodes.label: Capability Map
nodes.rationale: Phase 0 scope check for requests bundling multiple independently testable capabilities. Module ids (kebab-case, never renamed), dependency direction (no cycles), build order — approved before any module spec.

nodes.label: Spec Template
nodes.rationale: Six core areas: Objective, Tech Stack, Commands, Project Structure, Code Style, Testing Strategy, Boundaries (Always/Ask First/Never), Success Criteria, Open Questions.

nodes.label: Test-Driven Development
nodes.rationale: Write failing test before code (RED-GREEN-REFACTOR). For bugs: Prove-It Pattern — reproduction test first, then fix. Test pyramid: Unit ~80%, Integration ~15%, E2E ~5%.

nodes.label: Test Pyramid
nodes.rationale: Most tests small and fast; progressively fewer at higher levels. DAMP over DRY in tests. Prefer real implementations over mocks (real > fake > stub > mock). AAA pattern.

nodes.label: UI/UX Pro Max
nodes.rationale: UI/UX design intelligence: 79 styles (50 active), 192 palettes, 74 font pairings, 119 UX guidelines, 105 icons, 17 GSAP presets, 25 chart types, 22 stacks. Used when task involves UI structure, visual design, interaction, or UX quality.

nodes.label: UI/UX Rule Categories by Priority
nodes.rationale: 10 priority categories: 1) Accessibility CRITICAL, 2) Touch & Interaction CRITICAL, 3) Performance HIGH, 4) Style Selection HIGH, 5) Layout & Responsive HIGH, 6) Typography & Color MEDIUM, 7) Animation MEDIUM, 8) Forms & Feedback MEDIUM, 9) Navigation Patterns HIGH, 10) Charts & Data LOW.

nodes.label: Pro Rules (App UI Pre-Delivery Checklist)
nodes.rationale: Common rules for professional native/mobile app UI: icons (no emoji, vector-only, consistent sizing), interaction (tap feedback, gesture conflicts), light/dark mode contrast, layout (safe areas, 4/8dp rhythm), canonical pre-delivery checklist.

nodes.label: Quick Reference (10 UX Rule Categories)
nodes.rationale: Full rule set for all 10 categories with specific rules: color-contrast 4.5:1, touch-target-size 44x44pt/48x48dp, bottom-nav-limit 5 items, viewport-meta, focus-not-obscured, etc.
